Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

liteq 1.2.0

  • publish() now accepts multiple messages (note that title and message must be of the same length) and publishes them in a single transaction (#25, @Enchufa2).

  • Setting the R_LITEQ_BUSY_TIMEOUT environment variable now works properly. Previously it was ignored and the timeout was set to ten seconds (#24, @Enchufa2).

  • liteq now works better with many concurrent workers, and fails much less often with “database is locked” errors (#28, #29, @Enchufa2):

    • Checking for crashed workers does not wait for the busy timeout on each message that is being worked on. Previously, this kept the database locked for a long time, for the busy timeout times the number of active workers.

    • All write transactions now use BEGIN IMMEDIATE. This avoids deadlocks between writers, and readers (e.g. list_messages()) are not blocked while another process is writing.

    • All write operations, including ensure_queue() and publish(), now keep waiting for the database lock, like consume() and ack() already did. Previously they failed if they did not get the lock within the busy timeout.

liteq 1.1.0

CRAN release: 2019-03-08

  • Work around a SQLITE bug that resets the database busy timeout after a successful query. Now we set the timeout after each database operation. The timeout can now also be set via the R_LITEQ_BUSY_TIMEOUT environment variable, and it defaults to 10 seconds, instead of 1 second.

  • consume() now has a poll_interval argument to set how often to poll the queue for new jobs.

  • New is_empty() and message_count() functions (#18, @wlandau).

  • Get rid of annoying warning about closing unused connections (#15, #20, @wlandau).

liteq 1.0.1

CRAN release: 2017-10-20

  • Set the LITEQ_CACHE_DIR environment variable to change the default cache directory.

liteq 1.0.0

CRAN release: 2017-01-27

First public release.
